entities.name: John Yi Yun-il
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: John Yi Yun-il was a Korean Catholic who was killed during the 19th-century Korean persecution of Christians. He was a family man who made his living as a farmer and who also served as a catechist, i.e. a teacher of Christian religion.
